(Japanese: 赤の巻：クノイチの事情 The Scarlet Scroll: Kunoichi's Situation) is the fourth chapter of the Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~ manga

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Kunoichi spies on Nixtorm Castle and steals Okuni's collection on the male Warlords.
Gracia and Okuni mistake Kunoichi's appearance as a scandalous elopement with Mitsuhide and tries to stop it.
During the fight between them, an avalanche starts, only for Yukimura to arrive and save everyone. 
Yukimura takes Kunoichi back to Terrera.
